OTHER PROCEDURES
In view of the small number of wound infections that would be prevented by systemic antimicrobial prophylaxis the risks outweigh benefits for patients who will have cardiac catheterization, varicose vein surgery, most dermatologic and plastic surgery, arterial puncture, thoracentesis, paracentesis, repair of simple lacerations, outpatient treatment of burns, dental extractions, or root canal therapy.
